chapters.label: Last minute, live
chapters.text: Nineteen ninety-seven, Denmark against Greece. Nil-nil, last minute: a draw sends Denmark to the World Cup. Suddenly a Greek striker is clean through on Peter Schmeichel!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Schmeichel races off his line to get close to him.

chapters.label: The star jump
chapters.text: From behind the goal: he jumps into a giant star, arms and legs wide, and blocks the shot!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Denmark are off to the World Cup! Your turn: when a striker gets close, spread your arms and legs wide like a star to block the shot.
